videoV1.quoteHint: This quote does not reserve credits. Confirmation reserves credits from your shared image and video balance before input review and generation.

videoV1.backgroundHint: Once accepted, your task continues on the server even if this page closes. Recover it from Video history.
videoV1.emptyResult: Your video status will appear here
videoV1.privateHint: Playback and download become available only after the stored video passes review.
videoV1.disabled: New video requests are currently unavailable. Existing tasks remain available in Video history.
videoV1.jobUnavailable: Unable to refresh this task. It may still be running. Sign in to the same account and refresh its status.
videoV1.playbackExpired: Private playback is unavailable or its access link expired. Request a fresh authorization.
videoV1.downloadFailed: Download authorization failed. Try again to request a fresh link.
videoV1.historyHint: Only your account’s video tasks appear here. Refresh or return after closing the browser to restore their server status.

stageDescriptions.QUEUED: Your request is saved. The provider has not yet confirmed acceptance.
stageDescriptions.INPUT_REVIEW: Your prompt and any secured reference are being checked before generation.
stageDescriptions.SUBMITTING: The server is submitting one generation request. Keep this task to follow its status.
stageDescriptions.SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN: The provider may have accepted this request. We are checking the original attempt and will not submit it again automatically.
stageDescriptions.GENERATING: The provider has confirmed acceptance. No completion percentage is available.
stageDescriptions.STORING: The generated result is being stored privately. Storage recovery uses the same generated result.
stageDescriptions.OUTPUT_REVIEW: The stored file is being reviewed. Playback and download remain unavailable.
stageDescriptions.FINALIZING: Delivery eligibility and the credit settlement are being confirmed.
stageDescriptions.READY: The stored video passed the required checks. You can request private playback or download.
stageDescriptions.REJECTED: The required content checks rejected this request or its result. See the credit status below.
stageDescriptions.FAILED: This task did not complete delivery. See the credit status below; a new generation is not started automatically.
stageDescriptions.NEEDS_REVIEW: The task needs a server-side review. Keep this task ID. Its credit reservation may remain in place until the result is confirmed.

errors.promptLength: Use the selected model’s character limit and stay within 10,000 text units; some characters use two units.
errors.imageRequired: Upload and secure one reference image first.
errors.invalidImage: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.imageTooLarge: This image exceeds the allowed size or is empty.
errors.upload: The image could not be uploaded or secured. Choose it again to retry the upload.
errors.quoteExpired: The quote expired or is no longer valid. Review the current cost again.
errors.priceUnavailable: Video pricing is temporarily unavailable. Please check back later.
errors.conflict: This confirmation does not match the original request. Review a new quote before confirming.
errors.insufficientCredits: There are not enough available credits. Images and videos use the same balance. Open billing to review your credits.
errors.ownerBusy: Your account has reached its active video task limit. Wait for one of your tasks to finish, then try again.
errors.globalBusy: The video service is temporarily at capacity. Please try again later.
errors.providerBusy: The video generation provider is temporarily at capacity. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait briefly before trying again. If a confirmation is pending, check that same request before starting another.
errors.disabled: New video requests are currently unavailable.
errors.unauthorized: This action is unavailable to this account. Sign in again if your session expired.
errors.network: The response was interrupted. Use “Check the same request” to recover the original task.
errors.unavailable: The request could not be confirmed. If a confirmation is pending, check that same request before starting another.
errors.unsupportedSelection: Choose a supported model and settings combination.
